**Position** 
 – Quality Assurance Associate (On site)
   

  

**Location** 
 \- Maersk CFS, Ground Floor No 78, Anuppam pattu village, Minjur, Ponneri Taluka, Thiruvalluvar dist, Chennai\- 601204
   

  

**Description** 
 \-Responsible for ensuring quality, food safety, regulatory compliance, cold\-chain integrity, and QMS implementation across the warehousing and cold storage facility.
   

  

 Work closely with Operations, Engineering/Maintenance, Safety, Commercial and customers to ensure that products are stored and handled in accordance with customer requirements, approved SOPs, food safety standards, statutory regulations and company policies. Act as the key quality interface for customer audits, regulatory inspections, complaints, CAPA, HACCP/FSMS implementation, temperature management and continuous improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Operational Management \-**
* Ensure operations are optimized and warehousing services are delivered under the highest service quality possible in the area.
* Ensure maintenance and renewal of applicable licenses, registrations and statutory approvals, including FSSAI, EIC, MPEDA and other applicable regulatory requirements, depending on the products handled.
* Participation in internal and external audits (Food safety audits, ISO audits, customer audit, third party certification audits, etc)
* Review temperature records, deviations and corrective actions on a regular basis.
* Ensure proper functioning, calibration and validation of temperature monitoring devices, data loggers, sensors and measuring equipment.
* Develop, review and implement SOPs, work instructions, quality manuals, checklists and formats for warehouse and cold storage operations.
* Ensure effective implementation of GMP, GHP, hygiene, sanitation and food safety practices across the facility.
* Ensure timely customer complaints handling with effective root cause analysis.
* Keeping records and manual in the QMS documentation updated with revision as per standards.
* Prepare the facility for planned and unplanned audits and inspections. Ensure closure of audit observations within agreed timelines.
* Handling of government officials visiting facility.
* Ensuring effective pest control program for site.
* Prepare quality manuals for various categories of products stored in the facility.
* Assist in implementing various business excellence projects and initiatives at the site.
* Conduct quality, food safety, GMP/GHP, HACCP, hygiene, QMS and SOP\-related training for warehouse employees.
* Monitor quality trends and provide recommendations to Site Management.


**Client Relationship Management \-**
* Client audits.
* Product sampling.
* Quality Dashboard.


**Accountable For**
* Effective implementation of QMS, FSMS, HACCP and PRPs at the facility.
* Addressing all complaints / queries within timelines as per escalation matrix.
* Leading all quality audits for the facility.
* Quality documentation and record control.
* Training and awareness of warehouse personnel on quality and food safety requirements.


**Critical Competencies**
* Strong knowledge of QMS, FSMS, HACCP, GMP, GHP and PRPs.
* Understanding of ISO 9001 and ISO 22000 standards.
* Strong knowledge of SOP preparation and implementation.
* Ability to perform Root Cause Analysis and CAPA.
* Strong audit management and documentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


**Key Metrics**
* Handling Customer complaints \& ensuring high customer satisfaction Score.
* QMS implementation and standardization.
* Regulatory license and statutory compliance.
* Successful completion of certification audits and observations closed within timelines.


**Education Qualification \& Experience:**
* B.E. Food Tech/ Science Graduate (microbiology/Biotech/Food Technology)
* 3\-4 Experience in Food manufacturing/handling (specially frozen food)
* Certification/training in ISO 9001:2015, ISO 22000, HACCP will be preferred.
* Experience in handling customer audits, food safety audits and regulatory inspections will be preferred.

description:
****About SKF****

 SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.
   

  





 The inherent skills and competence of our around 40,000 employees help us to fulfill our objective of creating more intelligent, sustainable and innovative customer solutions. SKF is a truly global company with presence in more than 130 countries, serving an extensive range of industries and customers worldwide. SKF started its operations in India in 1923\.
   

  





 SKF has hands\-on experience in over 40 industries with knowledge and a vast product portfolio across the SKF technology platforms: bearings and units, seals, lubrication systems, condition monitoring equipment, and services.
   

  





 We operate in four regions – the Americas, Europe, Middle East \& Africa, India \& Southeast Asia and China \& Northeast Asia – to serve customers with speed and responsiveness.
   

  





 SKF has been in India since more than 100 years and has a pan India footprint consisting of 6 manufacturing facilities, 12 offices, a supplier network of over 300 distributors and an employee base of more than 2600 dedicated professionals.
   

  





 To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in
   

  





**Innovation is the key:**




 We make some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions to reduce friction. But we sell something bigger. Less friction means more energy saved. And it means that society can move forward to a more energy\-efficient future where we can all do more with less.
   

  





**Sustainability:**




 At SKF, we have a long history of working with industrial sustainability. It is an integral part of what we do every day. And we strive to create engagement throughout the business, not only by implementing sustainability on a strategic level, but also by encouraging the ideas and grass root projects initiated by our people around the world.
   

  





****About Technology Development****




 The TD team for ISEA is focused on Customer Product development \& Engineering, Innovation for the region, rollout of new technologies for the region, testing, Failure Investigation, scaleup from POC to series production, Portfolio Management etc.
   

  





**TD Competencies**




* Engineering \& Research Centre
* Product Development \& Engineering – This division brings out conceptual/detailed designs to support BOH/ETO activities based on customer specifications. Technology trends like digitization of workflows, e\- Aviation, Sensorization, Product localization, Design automation, Agile, DFX and Model based designs, (MBDs) have increased the operational efficiency and application productivity. What our customer gain from this is efficient digital data exchange, traceability and flexibility in design changes, reduced carbon footprint and higher performance products.
* Testing : Group Testing Services is a trusted partner in design, process and supplier validation. The testing team ensures greater focus on customer requirements, quality and operational efficiency. This entails greater support for SKF’s processes in a faster manner by applying global test standards, adapted to local customer specific requirements.
* Global Metallurgy \& Chemistry Laboratory (GMC)
* Future Factory (Manufacturing 4\.0\) – Working on World class manufacturing – Lean, Green, Digital.
* Manufacturing Process \& Development \- We support factories in the areas of process development (Heat treatment), machine building, Advanced Manufacturing – HT simulations, Additive Manufacturing, Vision Inspection etc. We are working on building innovative solutions on machines (measurement/ assembly/ clean manufacturing) and focusing on Scaling technologies like 3D printing and Camera based Inspection system with automation.
* Connected Technologies \- develop new products for connectivity and sustain it. We work on sensor technology and data integration. This help customer for predictive maintenance of their assets






**SKF Purpose Statement**




 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet
   

  





**JOB DESCRIPTION**




**Job Title** 
 : Associate Material Failure Analyst
   

  





**Reports To** 
 : Manager Bearing investigation
   

  





**Role Type** 
 : Individual Contribution
   

  





**Location** 
 : Bangalore
   

  





**Role Purpose:**




 To support engineer and also carry out investigation on products with high quality and speed for identify potential root cause through the process of systematic analysis. Also effectively utilize resources of Lab with optimum cost implications and maximum efficiency
   

  





**Key Deliverables:** 
  

  





* 
+ Preparation of metallographic samples for metallography and performing basic metallographic inspection as per schedule.
+ Operation and basic maintenance of X Ray diffraction machine
+ Operation and basic maintenance of scanning electron microscope
+ Operating Rockwell, Vickers \& Micro Vickers hardness tester and to check chemical composition of steel using Optical emission spectrometer, Carbon and Sulphur analyzer and Oxygen and nitrogen gas analysis.
+ Support SEM analysis and EDS analysis of particles.
+ Perform Sample preparation for Level1 bearing analysis.
+ Communicating and coordinating with the customers and stake holders for collecting relevant inputs and performing the analysis and concluding on RCA
+ Make stakeholders aware on complaint handling process and take required support from various functions of SKF for carrying out effective investigation.
+ To ensure that equipment’s are periodically calibrated.
+ To ensure that equipment’s undergo preventive maintenance by coordinating with service providers Viz – suppliers, purchase etc.
+ Participate in ensuring continuous improvement of performance indicators of the projects.
+ Take timely actions on the action points given during the audits.
+ Actively participate in 5S, bridge meetings, improvement meeting, etc.
+ To follow management instructions and procedures to report Environment Health and Safety (EHS) risks and EHS related incidents; to follow quality specifications and requirements and identify quality risks and opportunities for improvement.
+ Meeting all requirements of the Quality management system, such as Interlaboratory comparison, Proficiency testing and uncertainty measurement.
+ Monitoring of environment conditions.
+ Adhering of Preventive maintenance scheduling.
+ Material handling and tracking.






**Competencies:**




**Functional**




 Hands\-on experience metallographic sample preparation, microstructure analysis and mechanical and chemical testing.
   

  





 Hand on experience in operating SEM And XRD machine
   

  





 Basic knowledge on failure analysis
   

  





 Should have knowledge on steel making, heat treatment and forming operations.
   

  





 Basic knowledge on lubricant properties and its influence on performance characteristics.
   

  





**Managerial /Leadership:**




 Stake holder management.
   

  





**Candidate Profile:** 
  

  





* 
+ Experience: 3\- 6 Years.
+ Education: Diploma in metallurgical engineering streams.
+ Industry Type: Industrial or Automotive






****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

description:
**Lead Quality Customer Delivery (P\&C Insurance) Coimbatore** 




**Role Overview** 




**We are an insurtech company focused exclusively on P\&C insurance. As a Quality Manager in the Customer Delivery organization, you will be responsible for establishing and driving quality practices across customer implementations on our policy administration platform. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Project Managers, and configuration teams to ensure that insurance products, forms, workflows, and rating logic are configured accurately and delivered with high quality. This role requires a strong understanding of structured testing methodologies, process improvement, and the ability to leverage AI\-enabled tools to improve quality outcomes and delivery efficiency.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




** Define and maintain quality standards, testing frameworks, and validation processes for insurance product configuration, forms, workflows, and rating logic** 




** Review configured solutions against source documents, business requirements, and rating specifications to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency** 




** Lead defect management activities, including triage, root cause analysis, trend identification, and preventive action planning** 




** Drive continuous improvement initiatives across delivery processes using structured quality methodologies and measurable quality metrics** 




** Collaborate with Business Analysts, Project Managers, and development teams to establish quality checkpoints throughout the implementation lifecycle** 




** Build and maintain quality dashboards, reporting mechanisms, and delivery scorecards to provide visibility into quality performance and improvement opportunities** 




** Evaluate, adopt, and contribute to AI\-enabled solutions for test case generation, test automation, defect analysis, and quality monitoring** 




** Mentor team members on testing best practices, insurance domain concepts, and quality\-focused delivery approaches** 




**Required Skills and Experience** 




** 6–10 years of experience in quality assurance, quality management, business analysis, or delivery roles, with significant exposure to enterprise software implementations** 




** Strong understanding of testing methodologies, defect management, and quality governance practices** 




** Ability to analyze complex business requirements and validate configured solutions against expected outcomes** 




** Experience designing test cases and test strategies for rule\-driven or configurable systems** 




** Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and drive process improvements** 




** Experience working with project and delivery management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms** 




** Interest in AI and automation, with the ability to evaluate and implement AI\-driven quality improvements** 




**Nice to Have** 




** Prior experience in P\&C insurance or insurtech** 




** Familiarity with insurance rating logic, policy forms, underwriting workflows, and bureau\-based rating content** 




** Experience with policy administration systems or no\-code/low\-code platforms** 




** Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent process improvement certification** 




** Experience building quality metrics, dashboards, and operational reporting frameworks**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive Automation Tester / QA Engineer to

support automated and manual testing of web and mobile applications. The role involves

creating and executing automated test scripts, identifying and reporting defects, and

working closely with developers to ensure product quality. This is a great opportunity to

build strong skills and a career in QA Automation.

* Develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts for web and/or mobile applications under appropriate guidance.
* Perform manual and automated testing to identify functional and technical issues.
* Create and execute test cases based on product requirements and specifications.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and usability testing.
* Identify, document, and track software defects using tools such as Jira or Bugzilla.
* Retest resolved defects and performed regression testing to ensure issues have been properly fixed.
* Support the development and maintenance of automation frameworks using tool such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or Appium.
* Write and maintain clean, reusable, and well\-organized automation scripts.
* Analyze automated test results and report failures or unexpected behavior.
* Collaborate with developers and product teams to understand requirements and ensure quality standards.
* Maintain test cases, automation scripts, test data, documentation, and test reports.
* Participate in test planning and contribute ideas to improve test coverage and automation efficiency.
* Assist in identifying repetitive manual test scenarios that can be automated.

**Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Basic understanding of manual and automation testing concepts.
* Fundamental knowledge of at least one automation tool/framework such as:

o Selenium WebDriver

o Cypress

o Playwright

o Appium

* Basic programming/scripting knowledge in Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Understanding of locators, XPath/CSS selectors, assertions, waits, and basic test execution.
* Ability to write and execute test cases based on requirements.
* Basic knowledge of defect reporting and tracking tools such as Jira or Bugzilla.
* Understanding of functional, regression, smoke, and sanity testing.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

**Good to Have**

* Basic knowledge of SQL and database testing.
* Familiarity with API testing and tools such as Postman.
* Basic understanding of Git/GitHub or other version control systems.
* Familiarity with automation testing frameworks such as TestNG, JUnit, PyTest, or similar.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins.
* Exposure to web or mobile application testing projects.
* Relevant QA/testing certifications.
* Academic, internship, or personal projects involving test automation.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work on real\-world web/mobile applications.
* Hands\-on exposure to automation testing frameworks and tools.
* Learning and growth opportunities in QA and Test Automation.
* Collaborative and supportive work environment.
* Opportunity to develop skills in automation, API testing, databases, Git, and CI/CD.

Withum is a place where talent thrives \- where who you are matters. It’s a place of endless opportunities for growth. A place where entrepreneurial energy plus inclusive teamwork equals exponential results. Withum empowers clients and our professional staff with innovative tools and solutions to address their accounting, tax and overall business management and operational needs. As a US nationally ranked Top 25 firm, we recruit only the best and brightest people with a genuine passion for the business.
 



  





 The Innovation team is seeking a Senior Product Analyst within India. This role sits at the intersection of our Industry practices and our product development efforts, analyzing complex tax and business processes to be solved with automation and artificial intelligence. The Senior Product Analyst partners directly with accounting professionals to understand how work actually gets done, then translates that understanding into clear requirements, user stories, and delivered product capability.
 



  





 Withum’s brand is a reflection of our people, our culture and our strength. Withum has become synonymous with teamwork and client service excellence. The cornerstone of our success can truly be accredited to the dedicated professionals who work here every day, whose mission is to help our clients grow and thrive \- to be in a position of strength. But our commitment goes beyond our clients as we continue to live the Withum Way, promoting personal and professional growth for all team members, clients, and surrounding communities.
 



  





**How You’ll Spend Your Time** 




 • Acting as the primary interface between the Innovation team and the firm’s practice and Product managers translating process pain points into product requirements
 



 • Partnering with subject matter experts across compliance, provision, and advisory to document current\-state workflows and identify opportunities
 



 • Leading requirements definition and delivery for tax/audit\-focused products, including client intake, workpaper automation, document extraction, and review workflows
 



 • Writing user stories and acceptance criteria based on business\-driven functionality as well as technical capabilities (working with both the Product Owner and Innovation team)
 



 • Building and executing test scripts, coordinating user acceptance testing with teams, and triaging defects through resolution
 



 • Assisting with execution of product delivery and services which includes benefit realization (ROI of new products, features, tools, services, etc.)
 



 • Helping the Innovation team align change catalysts to ensure successful adoption and utilization of products within the Firm
 



 • Facilitating knowledge sessions, demonstrations, and training with subject matter experts and stakeholders across the firm
 



 • Tracking adoption, usage, and time savings, and reporting results back to Innovation and Practice leadership
 



 • Participating in sprint planning and project/process specification meetings
 



 • Understanding data movement and detailed knowledge of upstream and downstream systems, including accounting software platforms, and the interactions and dependencies between them
 



 • Seeking awareness of product scope (e.g. MVP) and providing input to define clear user stories to inform product development
 



  





**Requirements** 




 • Required Education Level: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Technology, Information Technology, or Management Information Systems
 



 • Required Years of Experience: 6\+ years’ experience preferred
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Copilot and the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including building or configuring Copilot agents, prompt design, and evaluating AI\-generated output
 



 • Familiarity with accounting technology platforms and document automation tools used in a professional services environment
 



 • Experience running user acceptance testing, writing test scripts, and managing defect triage
 



 • Agile and product management certifications with experience with Azure DevOps and User Story creation
 



 • Progress toward or desire to obtain Prosci and/or PMP certification
 



 • Strong personal and communication skills both written and verbal; ability to develop relationships with all stakeholders
 



 • Exhibits willingness to try new ideas, even when different than status quo
 



 • Ability to work with several technology platforms including Microsoft Office and various innovative tools and systems such as but not limited to Agile to define clear user stories
 



 • Ability to prepare charts, tables and diagrams to assist in analyzing problems, utilizing, if necessary, various business, scientific and/or engineering mathematical techniques
 



 • Responsive and ability to manage multiple projects and communications simultaneously
 



 • Excellent attention to detail; ability to multitask and adapt to shifting needs and priorities
 



 • Able to learn and adapt to new and complex procedures quickly
 



 • Excellent time management skills

title: HTML & Email Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
Role & responsibilities Job Description
HTML QA Specialist CRM
About the Role
We are looking for a meticulous and process-driven HTML QA Specialist to join our CRM team. In this role, you will be the final line of defence before email campaigns are deployed, responsible for thoroughly testing HTML email templates across all major clients and devices. You will work closely with HTML developers, designers, and the broader CRM team to ensure every campaign that goes out the door is pixel-perfect, fully functional, and free of errors.
Key Responsibilities
Review and QA HTML email templates built from Figma and Photoshop design files, validating accuracy against original design specs.
Test all email templates across major email clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Yahoo, etc.) and devices (desktop, mobile, tablet) using tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
Identify and clearly document bugs, rendering issues, and inconsistencies, raising them to HTML developers with detailed reproduction steps.
Validate all links within emails — checking for broken links, incorrect URLs, 404 errors, and correct regional link swaps (e.g. CA/US variants).
Check image rendering quality, including resolution, correct asset exports, and proper display across clients.
Review dynamic and personalised content (e.g. first name tokens, product recommendations) for accuracy and fallback behaviour.
Perform pre-deployment QA checks on send counts, subject lines, preheader text, sender details, and UTM parameters.
Maintain a QA checklist and contribute to the ongoing improvement of QA processes and guardrails.
Collaborate with the Project Management team to ensure QA is completed within campaign timelines without compromising quality.
Flag and escalate repeat error patterns to help identify systemic issues in the development workflow.
Required Skills & Experience
Experience in QA testing for HTML email campaigns, with an understanding of how emails render across clients.
Working knowledge of HTML and inline CSS — enough to read, understand, and pinpoint issues in email code.
Experience using email testing tools such as Litmus, Email on Acid, or similar platforms.
Familiarity with Figma and Adobe Photoshop — able to reference design files to validate builds against original specs.
Strong attention to detail with a zero-defect mindset and the ability to spot subtle rendering and content errors.
Experience reviewing dynamic content, personalisation tokens, and conditional logic within email templates.
Understanding of email client rendering quirks, particularly Outlook's rendering engine and its limitations.
Ability to write clear, structured bug reports with supporting screenshots and reproduction steps.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Nice to Have
Hands-on experience with ESP platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Braze) including proof and deployment workflows.
Understanding of AMPscript, HubL, or Liquid templating languages for reviewing dynamic content logic.
Familiarity with accessibility best practices for email (e.g. alt text, colour contrast, semantic structure).
Experience with version control tools such as Git.
Knowledge of email deliverability principles, including image-to-text ratios and spam trigger awareness.
Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
What We're Looking For
A methodical, thorough approach to testing — someone who takes pride in catching issues others miss.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to give precise and constructive feedback to developers.
A collaborative mindset — comfortable working closely with developers, designers, and project managers.
Proactive in identifying patterns and suggesting process improvements to prevent recurring issues.
Calm under pressure, with the ability to prioritise and work efficiently when campaign deadlines are tight.
Candidate should be willing to work in the rotational shifts Preferred candidate profile

Key Skills: CSS,HTML,HTML QA Specialist,Salesforce Marketing Cloud,CRM,HubSpot,Klaviyo,Braze

title: Sr. QA Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior QA Engineer with 4-5 years of hands-on experience in Manual and Automation Testing. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in software quality assurance, test planning, test execution, defect management, API and database testing, and automation framework development. The candidate should have a strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and modern QA practices. Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright is expected, with Playwright preferred. The role will involve working closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure high-quality, reliable, and scalable software releases. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Test Planning Strategy: Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to define test strategies, scope, effort, timelines, and test coverage. Manual Testing: Design and execute comprehensive test cases and scenarios covering functional, regression, integration, system, smoke, sanity, exploratory, and UAT testing. Test Documentation: Create and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios, test data, test execution reports, and other QA documentation. Automation Testing: Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using industry-standard automation tools and frameworks. Automation Framework Development: Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable and reusable automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber, or Appium. Regression Smoke Automation: Automate regression and smoke test suites to improve test coverage, execution efficiency, and release cycles. Defect Management: Identify, document, track, prioritize, and verify defects throughout the defect lifecycle using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. API Testing: Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, SOAP UI, and Swagger/OpenAPI. Database Testing: Validate database records, data integrity, data flow, and backend processes using SQL and relational databases. End-to-End Testing: Validate complete business workflows across applications, APIs, databases, and integrated systems. CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing practices. Quality Risk Management: Perform risk-based testing, identify potential quality risks, and recommend appropriate testing strategies and mitigation approaches. Performance Optimization: Analyze test execution and automation results, troubleshoot failures, and continuously improve test coverage and execution efficiency. Agile Collaboration: Participate in Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives. Release Validation: Support release and deployment validation activities and ensure software meets defined quality standards before production release. Quality Improvement: Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, standards, tools, frameworks, and best practices. Technical Contribution: Participate in code reviews, test strategy discussions, technical discussions, and automation roadmap planning. Mentoring: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior QA engineers and contribute to building overall team capabilities. 
 
 Required Skills & Qualifications

description:
**Typesider \| Noida \| Hybrid \| Full\-time \| 0–3 Years** 




 Compensation:
 **₹3–5 LPA** 




  




**About Typesider** 

 Typesider is a reward based Windows desktop application that turns everyday computer activity into tangible rewards.
 



 Users earn Typoints based on keyboard keystrokes and mouse clicks while using their computers normally. Typoints can be redeemed for coupons, discounts, exclusive brand offers, and soon, cashback.
 



 Typesider is designed to work seamlessly in the background and follows a privacy first approach. It counts activity volume but does not read, record, or store what users type or the content of their computer activity.
 



 We’re building a consumer product where reliability, usability, privacy, and trust are critical.
   




**About the Role** 

 We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Test Engineer to help us test and improve Typesider as we continue developing and releasing the product.
 



 You’ll work closely with the product and development teams to test the Windows application, identify bugs, explore edge cases, and ensure new features work reliably for real users.
 



 This is a hands on role where you’ll have a direct impact on product quality.
   




**What You’ll Do** 

 • Test the Typesider Windows desktop application across different user scenarios
 



 • Create, document, and execute manual test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Test the complete user journey, including installation, onboarding, streaks, reward days, reward claims, and redemption
 



 • Test new features and product updates before release
 



 • Identify bugs, edge cases, and usability issues
 



 • Document bugs clearly with steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, severity, and supporting information
 



 • Verify fixes and perform regression testing
 



 • Test different Windows environments and user scenarios
 



 • Work closely with developers and the product team to understand and resolve issues
 



 • Think like a real user and identify issues that could impact trust, engagement, retention, and overall experience
 



 • Help improve testing processes and documentation as the product grows
   




**What We’re Looking For** 

 • 0–3 years of experience in QA, software testing, or a related field
 



 • Freshers and candidates with 1–3 years of experience are welcome to apply
 



 • Good understanding of manual testing and software testing principles
 



 • Ability to create and execute clear test cases and test scenarios
 



 • Understanding of functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
 



 • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify bugs and edge cases
 



 • Ability to write clear and reproducible bug reports
 



 • Good analytical and problem solving skills
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication skills
 



 • Comfortable working closely with developers and product teams
 



 • Willingness to explore a product deeply and question how things work
   




**Good to Have** 

 • Experience testing Windows desktop applications
 



 • Familiarity with Jira or similar bug tracking tools
 



 • Basic understanding of API testing
 



 • Exposure to automation testing or QA automation tools
 



 • Experience testing consumer software or applications involving rewards, subscriptions, payments, or user accounts
   




**What We Value** 

 We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow a checklist.
 



 A good QA engineer should be able to ask:
 



 What happens if the user does this?
 



 What happens if the system fails here?
 



 Can this feature be misunderstood or misused?
 



 Does this actually work the way a real user would expect?
 



 Your ability to think through these scenarios and uncover problems will be a major part of the role.
   




**Why Join Typesider** 

 Typesider is an early stage consumer product, so you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with the team building the product and see your work directly influence releases.
 



 You’ll be testing a product used by real users and helping build the quality standards and QA processes as the product grows.

title: Quality Analyst – Manual Testing
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Analyst to lead manual testing efforts for the Customer Portal, a React/AEM\-based web application integrated with SAP, Salesforce, and supporting middleware. The QA will validate end\-to\-end business scenarios spanning the web/AEM front end and SAP\-driven backend processes (orders, deliveries, invoices, documents), ensuring the portal meets functional, data\-accuracy, and customer\-experience requirements before release.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Test Planning \& Strategy: Define the manual test strategy and test plans for each Phase 1 module (Profile, Documents, Contact Us, Dashboard, Deliveries, Order Status), covering functional, regression, integration, and UAT\-support testing.
* Test Case Design: Author detailed test cases and test scripts derived from business requirement documents, including field\-level validations, business rules, and source\-system mappings (e.g., SAP, SFDC).
* SAP\-Integrated Scenario Testing: Validate portal behavior against SAP\-driven data and logic, including order status transitions, delivery commitment / delay logic, credit/pricing/compliance blocks, invoice and document availability, and output management triggers.
* Web/UI Testing: Perform functional, cross\-browser, responsive, and accessibility testing of the React/AEM front end, including forms, search/filter behavior, modals, file uploads/downloads, and navigation flows.
* Data Validation: Verify data accuracy and consistency across SAP, Salesforce (SFDC), and the portal UI, including account details, contact information, order/delivery data, and document metadata.
* Defect Management: Log, triage, and track defects to closure using the team's defect management tool, working closely with React developers, AEM SMEs, and SAP consultants on root cause and resolution.
* Requirement Traceability: Maintain requirements\-to\-test\-case traceability matrices to ensure full coverage of documented requirements and sign\-off criteria.
* Regression \& Release Testing: Execute regression test cycles ahead of each release, validate bug fixes, and provide go/no\-go quality input to the Project Lead.
* UAT Support: Support business stakeholders during User Acceptance Testing, including test data preparation, issue triage, and coordination of retesting.
* Documentation: Maintain clear test documentation, execution logs, and status reporting (pass/fail metrics, defect trends, coverage) for project stakeholders.


**Must\-Have Skills**
* Experience: 5\+ years of manual QA experience with at least 2\+ years testing applications integrated with SAP and modern web front ends.
* SAP Exposure: Working knowledge of SAP Sales \& Distribution (Order\-to\-Cash) processes – Sales Orders, Deliveries, Billing/Invoicing, Customer Master – sufficient to validate business rules and data displayed on the portal.
* Web Application Testing: Hands\-on experience testing React\-based or other modern JavaScript web applications, including responsive/cross\-browser testing; exposure to CMS/DXP platforms such as AEM is a plus.
* Test Management Tools: Proficiency with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA/Xray, Azure DevOps, qTest, or similar).
* API/Integration Awareness: Ability to validate data flowing through REST/GraphQL APIs and integration layers (e.g., Apigee) at a functional level, using tools such as Postman.
* CRM Exposure: Familiarity with Salesforce (SFDC) data structures (Accounts, Contacts, Cases) as they relate to customer and case data shown on the portal.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to design test scenarios covering complex business/status logic (e.g., order and delivery lifecycle states).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for defect reporting and stakeholder coordination.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, including participation in sprint ceremonies and Definition of Done reviews.


**Added Advantage (Highly Preferred)**
* Experience testing AEM (Sites/SPA Editor) authored pages and AEM Dispatcher\-cached content.
* Exposure to SAP transaction codes relevant to customer master and order data (e.g., XD03\) for cross\-verification during testing.
* Experience testing Salesforce Case creation/workflow integrations.
* Basic SQL knowledge for backend data verification.
* ISTQB Foundation Level certification.


**Qualifications**
* B.E / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent.
* ISTQB or equivalent QA certification is a plus.

title: Senior Salesforce Tester
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company's patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.



Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**



Our Digital team at Azurity is building new capabilities utilizing cutting\-edge Salesforce technologies. We are seeking a dynamic, self\-driven, hands\-on team member who thrives in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.



The Senior Salesforce Tester is responsible for testing and validating Salesforce applications to ensure quality, performance, security, and regulatory compliance across Azurity's commercial and medical business processes. This role focuses on Salesforce platforms supporting HCP/HCO engagement, sales operations, patient support programs, regulatory requirements, and commercial excellence initiatives.



The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to identify defects, improve functionality, and maintain compliance with HIPAA, GDPR, Sunshine Act, and FDA regulations.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Test Planning \& Strategy**


* Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data for Salesforce applications.
* Ensure comprehensive coverage for functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing.
* Collaborate with business analysts, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and define testing strategies.
* Participate in test estimation, release planning, and risk assessment activities.


**Functional \& Regression Testing**


* Conduct manual and automated testing of Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud functionalities.
* Validate HCP/HCO engagement processes, KOL management, consent management, patient support workflows, and compliance\-related business processes.
* Perform end\-to\-end validation of business workflows, data integrity, and system configurations.
* Verify territory alignment, call planning, sample management, omnichannel engagement, and commercial operations processes.
* Execute regression testing to ensure system stability across Salesforce releases and deployments.


**Integration \& Data Testing**


* Test integrations with third\-party pharmaceutical platforms including IQVIA, Veeva, MedPro, SAP, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Validate Salesforce APIs (REST and SOAP) and perform API testing using Postman.
* Verify Data Cloud integrations, data ingestion, transformation, and synchronization processes.
* Ensure data accuracy, completeness, reconciliation, and security across integrated systems.
* Support testing of end\-to\-end data flows between Salesforce and enterprise applications.


**Compliance \& Security Testing**


* Ensure HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements are met across Salesforce solutions.
* Perform role\-based security testing, user access validation, permission testing, and audit trail verification.
* Validate electronic records controls, consent management processes, and sensitive data protection requirements.
* Support compliance documentation and validation activities as required for regulated systems.


**Performance \& Automation Testing**


* Use Copado Robotic Testing (CRT) or similar automation tools to automate Salesforce test cases.
* Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated test suites.
* Perform performance and scalability testing to assess system stability under peak workloads.
* Identify bottlenecks, optimize test execution, and validate Lightning Web Component (LWC) performance.
* Utilize basic Python scripting where applicable to support automation and data validation activities.


**Defect Tracking \& Collaboration**


* Document, manage, and track defects using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management tools.
* Work closely with developers and business analysts to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and release readiness activities.


**Continuous Improvement \& Best Practices**


* Stay current with Salesforce releases, platform enhancements, testing tools, and industry best practices.
* Implement CI/CD testing methodologies leveraging Copado and Salesforce DevOps processes.
* Recommend improvements to test automation frameworks, testing methodologies, and quality processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, quality, and compliance.


**Required Skills and Experience**


* 7\+ years of experience in Salesforce testing, preferably within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or Healthcare industries.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Life Sciences Cloud.
* Strong knowledge of manual and automated testing frameworks for Salesforce applications.
* Experience testing Salesforce integrations with pharmaceutical platforms such as IQVIA, Veeva, SAP, Sales Enablement tools, Snowflake, and MDM solutions.
* Proficiency in Salesforce Administration, Flows, Apex test classes, and Lightning Web Component (LWC) testing.
* Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP), Postman, and Data Cloud validation.
* Hands\-on experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release management practices.
* Understanding of HIPAA, GDPR, FDA, and pharmaceutical compliance requirements.
* Experience using JIRA, X\-Ray, or similar test management and defect\-tracking tools.
* Basic Python knowledge to support test automation and data validation activities.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills within a global offshore\-onshore delivery model.


**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience with Copado Robotic Testing and Salesforce DevOps release pipelines.
* Experience validating Snowflake, MDM, SAP, Veeva, IQVIA, MedPro, or other pharmaceutical data integrations.
* Basic Python skills for test utilities, data validation, or automation support.
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum delivery, risk\-based testing, and software quality practices in a regulated environment.
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial operations and HCP/HCO engagement processes.
* Experience with Data Cloud, AI\-enabled Salesforce capabilities, and advanced automation frameworks.

  

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

* Ability to work effectively with Swagger and OpenAPI specifications and API documentation.
* Strong SQL skills and experience validating data directly within relational databases.
* Experience testing integrations or distributed services where a transaction passes through multiple components.
* Ability to independently isolate whether a defect originates in source data, API processing, orchestration, persistence, or consumption.
* Experience designing or extending automated tests for APIs, integrations, or data pipelines.

* Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft SQL Server or Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, and cloud based services.

* Experience working with globally distributed engineering and product teams in an Agile delivery model.

 **Senior Test Automation Engineer**

**Requirements**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Java and TypeScript

* Develop robust API automation frameworks and automated validation strategies

* Identify and resolve automation framework, infrastructure, and test execution issues
* Establish coding standards, framework guidelines, and automation best practices
* Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, DevOps, and other technical stakeholders to improve overall product quality
* Review automation code and provide technical guidance to engineering teams
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers in automation architecture, framework development, and testing practices
* Evaluate new automation technologies and identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency
* Contribute to continuous improvement of test strategy, coverage, tooling, and engineering processes

* 5\+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, or quality engineering
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Java and TypeScript
* Advanced experience with Playwright and Selenium
* Proven experience designing and architecting scalable test automation frameworks
* Experience developing reusable testing libraries or shared frameworks adopted by multiple teams
* Strong experience with API automation and automated service\-level testing
* Hands\-on experience with distributed and parallel test execution
* Strong understanding of scalable test infrastructure, automation architecture, and framework design principles
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Strong hands\-on experience with GitHub Actions and Git\-based development workflows
* Excellent understanding of testability, maintainability, reliability, and automation best practices
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills with an ability to identify root causes of complex automation issues
* Experience working closely with software engineers, QA teams, DevOps, and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to mentor engineers and influence technical standards, automation practices, and engineering quality
* Proactive mindset with a strong focus on improving test coverage, execution efficiency, and release confidence

title: Principal Eng, Disposables
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
   

  

 We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
   

  

**Education Qualification**
 Bachelor’s/master’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent relevant technical degree.
   

  

 10 to 16years of relevant Experience in Systems \& Component level Verification \& Validation activities.
   

  

 Deep domain knowledge in design verification and validation of medical devices.
   

  

 Relevant technical testing/reliability experience in Plastic/Connectors/Products/electro\-mechanical.
   

  

 Understanding of hardware methodologies and test best practices.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Own and drive change control activities by ensuring accountability for all technical aspects of development, sustaining projects, and design controls.
   

  

 Lead the design and execution of R\&D studies, provide manufacturing support as needed, and contribute to product specifications.
   

  

 Drive the development, improvement, and troubleshooting of disposable manufacturing processes.
   

  

 Lead and implement changes through creative solutions, adapting to new product test methods and technologies while driving test automation to improve quality assurance and productivity in test deliverables.
   

  

 Partner with R\&D and cross\-functional teams to coordinate product integration and system testing, including automated testing.
   

  

 Plan, build, and maintain test infrastructure, including lab budget planning and management.
   

  

 Demonstrate the ability to achieve objectives and deliver multiple projects simultaneously.
   

  

 Develop and maintain effective, collaborative working relationships with internal and external stakeholders across levels and cultures.
   

  

 Lead V\&V activities to meet customer requirements, safety, regulatory, and quality expectations within committed timelines.
   

  

 Support corporate, internal, ISO, and regulatory audits by ensuring adherence to Vantive QMS requirements.
   

  

 Lead audit nonconformances or findings to closure by defining and implementing appropriate corrective actions.
   

  

 Lead and execute IQ, OQ, and PQ for equipment and instruments in accordance with QMS site policies.
   

  

 Ensure lab requirements are validated, and laboratories are qualified for intended use; coordinate shared equipment usage when needed.
   

  

 Qualify vendors and add them to the approved vendor list by coordinating with the sourcing team to ensure quick turnaround.
   

  

 Be self\-motivated with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to analyze and solve complex problems through innovative thinking and experience.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with mechanical equipment such as UTM, leak testers, torque testers, and other instruments or equipment would be an added advantage.
   

  

 Design and develop fixtures based on V\&V needs by preparing drawings and working closely with external vendors.
   

  

 Work with global cross\-functional teams to ensure completion of V\&V tasks.
   

  

 Exposure to regulatory standards, medical device manufacturing processes and procedures, RF welding, and solvent bonding would be an added benefit.
   

  

 Exposure to statistical tools such as Minitab and Six Sigma methodologies for results analysis would be an added advantage.
   

  

 Lead and execute assigned testing with minimal dependency on project owners by managing timelines, providing regular result updates, and owning final report preparation, review, sign\-off, and release.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Vantive is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. title: Technical Quality Assurance - Sr Professional I
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Technical Quality Assurance \- Sr Professional I
   

  

**About Your Role**
 You will join Fiserv in a quality assurance role supporting critical testing initiatives across compliance, business\-as\-usual releases, and migration programs. In this role, you will execute and plan testing activities for VisionPLUS\-related projects, with a focus on ensuring quality, traceability, and delivery readiness across card processing platforms. You will work closely with internal technology teams, user acceptance testing teams, and project stakeholders to deliver structured test execution and issue management for regulated financial services environments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Execute test planning and test execution activities for small projects and assigned release initiatives across compliance, BAU, and migration programs.
* Review business requirements and functional specification documents to define test scope, test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test scripts.
* Perform functional and system testing for VisionPLUS modules, with emphasis on CMS, FAS, TRAMS, and ITS.
* Coordinate daily end\-to\-end test activities with test managers and project teams to help ensure testing commitments and timelines are met.
* Document test execution results and provide end\-of\-day project test reporting for assigned initiatives.
* Manage defects independently using established defect management processes and tools, and act as a coordination point between UAT teams and internal technical teams.
* Support presentment file preparation and testing for card scheme processing and transaction validation.
* Use test management, defect management, automation, and AI\-enabled testing tools to support efficient execution and documentation of the testing lifecycle.
* Act as an incident management lead during dress rehearsal and go\-live events for assigned projects.
* Participate in continuous improvement activities to strengthen test processes, deliverables, and quality outcomes.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You’ll Need To Have**
* 4\+ years of experience in test planning, test execution, and test documentation for enterprise application testing projects.
* 4\+ years of experience in VisionPLUS modules, including CMS, FAS, TRAMS, and ITS.
* 4\+ years of experience in preparing test plans, test scenarios, and detailed test scripts from business requirements and functional specification documents.
* 4\+ years of experience in using test management and defect management tools such as ALM/QC, JIRA, or qTest.
* 4\+ years of experience in defect lifecycle management, issue triage, and coordination between user acceptance testing teams and technical delivery teams.
* 4\+ years of experience in scheme simulator testing for card networks such as Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, RuPay, or UPI.
* 4\+ years of experience in automated test case creation, maintenance, and execution using test automation frameworks.
* 4\+ years of equivalent combination of educational background, related experience, and/or military experience


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience with presentment file preparation and validation for card scheme testing.
* Experience using AI tools such as Copilot or Claude to improve test design, script creation, or test execution workflows.
* Experience supporting compliance testing, migration programs, and production readiness events in financial services.
* Experience serving as an incident management lead during dress rehearsals or go\-live activities.
* Experience representing QA status, risks, and issue resolution needs in stakeholder meetings.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. title: Validation Engineer
description:
Seeking a Validation Engineer (2–4 years exp) in Mechanical, Electronics, or Mechatronics to lead motor and gearbox performance testing, build test setups, and execute DVP\&R validation plans.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Join our engineering team as a Validation Engineer to drive performance, reliability, and quality across our advanced motor and gearbox product lines. In this hands\-on role, you will bridge R\&D and production by specifying dynamometers and test setups, executing end\-to\-end validation protocols (torque\-speed mapping, efficiency, thermal rise, backlash, and noise/vibration), and conducting root\-cause failure investigations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Work closely with Design/R\&D, Manufacturing, Quality, and Reliability teams.
* Provide feedback to design engineers on improvements for design\-for\-testability and design\-for\-reliability.
* Collaborate with design/R\&D teams to implement corrective actions.
* Design or specify test benches/dynamometers for motor performance testing (torque\-speed curves, efficiency mapping, back\-EMF, cogging torque).
* Motor testing: torque\-speed characteristics, efficiency, current draw, commutation accuracy (for BLDC/stepper), synchronous behavior, thermal rise, back\-EMF waveform, cogging/ripple torque.
* Investigate test failures (e.g., bearing failures, winding insulation breakdown, gear tooth pitting/wear, demagnetization).
* Plan validation across product lifecycle stages: component, sub\-system, and full assembly levels.
* Gearbox testing: efficiency, backlash, noise/vibration, lubrication effectiveness, gear tooth wear, thermal performance.
* Prepare validation test reports, DVP\&R sign\-off documents, and engineering change validation records.
* Support certification processes (EMI/EMC testing, safety testing).
* Maintain test data traceability and validation history for audits (ISO 9001, IATF 16949 if automotive\-adjacent).
* Define pass/fail criteria based on design specs, customer requirements, and standards (IEC 60034, NEMA, ISO, AGMA for gears, etc.).
* Continuously update technical knowledge and stay current with industry trends, design practices, and software tools.
* Participate in internal training sessions and support knowledge sharing within the team.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
 Experience: 2 \- 4 years
   

  

 Qualification: B.E. / Diploma in Mechanical / Electronics / Mechtronics

description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 The Supplier Quality Inspector is responsible for supplier inspection, supplier quality development, and resolution of quality issues related to castings, forgings, patterns, machined parts, and associated mechanical pump components. This role works closely with suppliers and internal cross\-functional teams to ensure product conformity, regulatory compliance, robust manufacturing processes, and continuous quality improvement.
   

  

**Roles and Responsibilities:**
 Manage incoming and source inspection activities for bought\-out items, including castings, forgings, patterns, machined components, and mechanical instruments. Review supplier quality documentation, including inspection reports, quality plans, Material Test Certificates (MTCs), and manufacturing records, to confirm compliance with drawings, specifications, standards, and company requirements. Interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T requirements, dimensional tolerances, surface\-finish requirements, material specifications, and inspection criteria. Conduct and support supplier process reviews to assess manufacturing capability, process control, repeatability, and product quality consistency. Develop, implement, and support supplier SOPs, inspection plans, process risk assessments, and mitigation actions. Identify quality issues at supplier locations during manufacturing, investigate root causes, and support timely containment, corrective actions, and process improvements. Lead NCR management with suppliers, ensuring effective root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, verification of effectiveness, and timely closure. Plan and conduct supplier audits for supplier qualification, periodic evaluations, quality\-performance improvement, and problem\-resolution activities. Coordinate and review NDT/NDE activities, as applicable, including:
   

  

* Visual Testing (VT)
* Magnetic Particle Testing (MT)
* Penetrant Testing (PT)
* Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
* Radiographic Testing (RT)
* Positive Material Identification (PMI)
* Hardness Testing


 Coordinate third\-party inspection activities, including scheduling, inspection readiness, documentation review, and follow\-up on observations or nonconformities. Ensure supplier compliance with ISO 9001:2015 QMS requirements, applicable material standards, API, ASME, ASTM \& ISO standards, customer requirements, and internal quality procedures. Work effectively with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Project Management, and Quality teams to resolve supplier\-related technical and quality concerns. Maintain clear communication with suppliers and internal stakeholders regarding inspection status, quality concerns, corrective\-action progress, and delivery\-impact risks. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen supplier capability, reduce repeat defects, improve process controls, and prevent recurrence of quality issues.
   

  

**Key Competencies:**
* Supplier quality management
* Casting, forging, pattern, and machining inspection
* Supplier audits and compliance management
* Engineering drawing interpretation and GD\&T
* Material certification and MTC review
* NDT/NDE coordination and evaluation
* NCR, CAPA, and corrective\-action management
* Root cause analysis and structured problem solving
* Process risk analysis and mitigation
* Continuous improvement
* Cross\-functional coordination
* Analytical thinking
* Ownership, accountability, and effective communication


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 6 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Supplier Quality, or Inspection, preferably in manufacturing, metal\-mechanical, pumps, casting, forging, Fabrications or heavy\-engineering industries.
* Hands\-on inspection experience with castings, forgings, patterns, machined components, Fabricated components and related mechanical parts.
* Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings, dimensional requirements, GD\&T, surface finish, material specifications, and inspection standards.
* Experience reviewing MTCs, inspection reports, NDT reports, dimensional reports, and supplier quality documentation.
* Knowledge of API, ASME, ASTM \& ISO standards, material standards, and ISO 9001:2015 quality\-management\-system requirements.
* Strong Knowledge in ASME standards Section II, V, VIII \& IX
* NDT Level II certification and practical experience in relevant methods such as VT, MT, PT, UT, RT, PMI, and hardness testing is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in supplier audits, root cause analysis, CAPA, NCR management, and supplier corrective\-action follow\-up.
* Ability to travel 70% to various regions of supplier locations for inspections, audits, supplier development, and quality issue resolution.
* Experience in pump, pressure\-containing equipment, or rotating\-equipment manufacturing.
* Familiarity with third\-party inspection agencies and customer inspection requirements.
* Experience applying quality tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, 8D, PFMEA, Control Plans, and Process Capability Analysis.

title: Associate Manager
description:
**About QCI** 




 The Quality Council of India (QCI) is the Scheme Owner of the Certification Scheme for Unmanned Aircraft Systems (CSUAS), which was notified in official gazette by the Ministry of Civil Aviation on 26 January 2022\. The scheme has since been revised and its scope enhanced, evolving into a Type based certification framework that covers Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) and Beyond Visual Line of Sight (BVLOS) UAS operations, and it also promotes the indigenisation and development of the domestic drone industry, contributing to the vision of India becoming a global drone hub by 2030\.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 As part of the team, you contribute to the development and operation of a national certification framework for UAS. Our work spans into designing and developing certification schemes aligned with international best practice, formulating technical standards, and creating certification ecosystems in partnership with industry, regulators, ministries, academia and other stakeholders, scale them through conformity assessment bodies. Deep understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential.
 



  





 The next phase of this work is about collaborating with the industry on the segments that still need enabling, namely autonomous drones, Drone\-as\-a\-Service and UAS traffic management, along with the digital transformation that simplifies compliance and the aggregator led facilitation that scales the use\-case adaptation to advance the growth of Industry These are areas where the standards, the quality assurance mechanisms and in some cases the market itself are still taking shape, and the people who join us now will help shape the Nation’s Drone Ecosystem.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibility** 




 QCI is seeking professionals to support the implementation of CSUAS. The role will contribute to the development and operation of the CSUAS workstreams below:
 



  




* **Scheme Design \& Development** 
 : Conceptualise UAS related quality interventions that help the industry and the regulator, and develop and revise the scheme criteria, technical standards and guidelines that give them effect with a in\-depth understanding of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS.



  




* **Research, Analysis \& Knowledge Products** 
 : Conduct rapid primary and secondary research on UAS domain and policy, including comparative study of standards and international best practice to draft standards for UAS and its components.



  




* **Report Writing \& Deck Preparation:** 
 Draft and structure reports, concept notes, technical circulars and knowledge products, and create data driven presentations for relevant stakeholders.



  




* **Scheme Operations** 
 : Lead the day to day operations of the scheme and its projects, scheme documentation, deliverables, work plans, trackers and minutes of meetings and report periodically on developments; collect, clean and analyse scheme data and maintain its records, website and dashboard; propose the features and changes required in the dashboard to support operations; monitor scheme\-related activities; coordinate with vendors and internal and external stakeholders; and frequently update FAQs.



  




* **Stakeholder Engagement** 
 : Identify key stakeholders, analyse their expectations, and develop and execute appropriate strategies to work with them; manage and regularly engage multiple stakeholders i.e., regulators, Certification Bodies, manufacturers, assessors, technical experts, laboratories and academia to ensure timely information exchange and seamless coordination.



  




* **Business Development \& Marketing of the Scheme** 
 : Ensure quantitative improvement in the number of Certification Bodies; identify potential clients and partners for adoption of the scheme; market the scheme to increase its uptake; and develop a comprehensive plan to improve scheme processes and revenue generation.



  





**Why this Role is a Unique Opportunity** 



* This is not a typical corporate role and the work you do here is not theoretical. You will be at the epicentre of the drone ecosystem, translating the Viksit Bharat @ 2047 vision into actionable, on\-the\-ground projects. We at QCI drive large scale programs that impacts millions of lives, not just produce reports and opinion pieces.



  




* We are looking for individuals those who want to look back at their careers and point to a specific national program and say, "I helped in building that”. If you have the intellectual rigor, a strong commitment to public service, and the resilience to navigate complex challenges, this is the place for you.



  





**Eligibility Criteria \& Requirements** 




**Educational Qualification** 
 :
 



  




* A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline is required. A Bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline, coupled with strong relevant experience, may also be considered for the Associate Manager role.



  




* An additional qualification in management, public policy, or conformity assessment ecosystem, or quality and compliance, or training in ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, or ISO/IEC 17024, or ISO/IEC 17020, or ISO 9001 will be considered a strong added advantage.



  





**Experience:** 



* Minimum three years of professional work experience in areas including manufacturing, R\&D, operations, consulting (private or government), or testing, auditing or a managerial role specifically in drone industry, or should have experience with stakeholder management, or operating a certification scheme, or national program.



  




* Knowledge of the Drone Rules, 2021 and CSUAS is essential, along with knowledge of the relevant rules and regulations with respect to drones operations in India and type certification.



  




* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, strong verbal communication, and sound organisational and planning skills, with a proven ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines, are required.



  




* Experience in marketing of products and creation of knowledge products is desired. Prior experience of working with government agencies, regulators or CABs in any capacity (operations or consulting) will be preferred.



  




* Working experience in any programming language, or with dashboards and AI tools, would be an added advantage. Exposure to UAS design, manufacturing, testing or flight operations, including VLOS/BVLOS flying experience, will be preferred though not mandatory.



  




* Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required. Fluency in Hindi, both written and oral, is desired.



  




* Location for the role is based out of New Delhi, on a full time engagement, with travel anywhere in India or abroad as and when required.



  




* The expected remuneration for this role would be between 5 to 10 LPA



  





**Technical Capabilities:** 




**Strong Research Skills:** 
 Ability to rapidly identify, read, and understand dense, technical documents (e.g., government reports and research papers) and extract the most relevant information.
 



**Structured Thinking \& Writing:** 
 Ability to break down large, ambiguous topics into a structured research plan and produce clear, logical, professional, and well\-written outputs.
 



**Data Analysis:** 
 Comfortable with data cleaning, essential MS Excel functions, and creating charts. Experience analysing survey data using Stata, R, or Python is an added advantage.
 



**Visualization \& Presentation Skills:**

description:
